reasons.A: Frost forking across the circle like rime on glass reads instantly as cold from the game camera, a form no existing kind can draw, with a crisp silhouette, real height in the side view and visible particles at the forks.
reasons.B: A two-armed spiral vortex winding out from the caster is new and reads as a spell rather than terrain at 0.25 s; it loses shape late as it breaks up, but the idea is strong.

fixes.A: Power barely shows from the game camera (SE3): grow branch length and reach more with power; the late frames are fainter than they need to be.
fixes.B: Its last two stills turn into a cluttered knot of blades and motes: tighten the fade so the spiral's shape stays legible to the end.

code_review.A: Fine to go in after one change: pose recomputes each branch's rotation every frame; compute it once in plan. Otherwise one cheap pass over planned pieces, clear names, numbers from the row.
code_review.B: Not reviewed in depth yet; read before porting.

notes: Mode collapse broken: three different forms (branching, spiral, sweep), no ring of spikes. All three failures ran out of 40 turns, none failed a check; kinds now gets 70. All three survivors asked for a painted frost-crystal particle texture: a strong signal for the next texture to paint. C (clock-hand sweep with rime crescents) passed over: too dark and thin to read at the game camera.
